newsitem.title: MACAU: Bottle explodes outside Macao police base.
newsitem.headline: Bottle explodes outside Macao police base.

text.p: A home-made bomb exploded outside the police headquarters in Portuguese-administered Macao on Thursday, police said.
A policeman told reporters the device, a bottle filled with gunpowder, damaged two cars but injured nobody, and blamed the attack on organised crime gangs.
During a night of violence earlier this week, three people were injured by machinegun fire, cars were set ablaze and a bomb was thrown.
Governor General Vasco Rocha Vieira on Thursday urged people in the territory to remain calm and to have confidence in the security forces's ability to fight against crime.
The latest bomb attack came only a few days before a tough new law on combatting organised crime comes into effect.
